procedure: Reused prior Ubuntu 24.04 arm64 acceptance image with osquery 5.23.1, Python 3.12.3 and MCP 1.30.0; no packages downloaded or image rebuilt
Copied only current Python sources, synthetic tests/harness and previously acquired public feed bundle; no host folders, Docker socket or personal data mounted
Ran product code as UID 10001 with capabilities dropped and no-new-privileges; synthetic peer shared only an internal Docker network, with no published ports
Established TCP socket to the synthetic peer without sending/receiving application payload; compared actual osquery PID/local-port/remote-port/protocol and sample deduplication

Replayed the first public feed and failed the second to exercise Linux atomic-store preservation; independently exercised real fixed downloader offline failure; checked current/previous hashes unchanged
Verified successful updater replay and next-request hourly denial in a separate new cache; did not mistake replay for live HTTPS success
Verified actual CLI details persisted only with explicit test permissions; anonymous SDK MCP used separate disabled history and blocked network/update/history callbacks
Checked generated detail dashboard statically; no browser opened
Exported aggregate summary only and removed both dedicated containers and internal network
limitations: Linux arm64 Ubuntu container on Docker, not physical Linux-host visibility or all distributions/CPUs
Observed target was a private synthetic peer, so destination state not_applicable is expected; real malicious public destinations were not contacted
Public-feed successful download was not exercised on Linux. Public bodies were copied/replayed, and actual offline failure returned before cancellation timer
Anonymous MCP was actual local Python SDK stdio, not a commercial GUI client; old identifier disclosure was enabled to verify new tool remained anonymous
Browser rendering/interaction not tested; generated HTML and actual saved observations checked statically
No Windows acceptance or new CI, full Python suite or npm rerun in this acceptance task
No product code changes; initial harness setup tar ownership/permissions corrected without adding capabilities

follow_up_live_update.scope: Actual Linux fixed-HTTPS update, TLS verification, hourly no-request denial and freshness boundaries verified separately; original offline/container observation results above unchanged
